acorn.meaning: the nut of an oak tree, sitting in a little cup

actor.meaning: a person who acts in films, TV or plays

acute.meaning: sharp or severe; (of an angle) less than 90°

admit.meaning: confess that something is true, or let someone in

adobe.meaning: sun-dried clay brick, or a house built from it

adopt.meaning: take a child as your own, or take up a new idea or habit

agent.meaning: a person who acts for others, e.g. in travel, property or spying

agree.meaning: have the same opinion, or say yes to something
agree.example: we agreed to meet at six

ahead.meaning: in front, or further on in time

aisle.meaning: a passage between rows of seats or shelves

alarm.meaning: a warning sound or device; sudden fear

album.meaning: a collection of songs released together, or a book for photos

alert.meaning: quick to notice things; also a warning

alien.meaning: a being from another planet; foreign or strange

align.meaning: place in a line or arrange so as to be parallel or straight
align.example: align the car with the curb

alike.meaning: having the same or similar characteristics

along.meaning: moving beside or following the length of

amber.meaning: a hard yellow-orange fossil resin, or that colour

among.meaning: in the middle of, or surrounded by, a group of things or people

angel.meaning: a heavenly being with wings; a very kind person

anger.meaning: a strong feeling of being upset or annoyed

angle.meaning: the space between two lines that meet, measured in degrees

ankle.meaning: the joint between the foot and the leg

apart.meaning: separated or at a distance in place or position or time
apart.example: These towns are many miles apart

apple.meaning: a round crisp fruit with red, green or yellow skin

apply.meaning: put something on; make a formal request; put to use

apron.meaning: a cloth tied around the waist to keep clothes clean while cooking

arena.meaning: a large venue for sports or concerts

argue.meaning: give reasons for a view, or quarrel

armor.meaning: protective covering made of metal and used in combat

array.meaning: an impressive range of things set out in order

arrow.meaning: a thin pointed shaft shot from a bow; a sign pointing the way

asset.meaning: something valuable you own, or a useful quality

attic.meaning: the room or space just under a roof

avian.meaning: pertaining to or characteristic of birds

avoid.example: Her former friends now avoid her

awake.meaning: not in a state of sleep
awake.example: lay awake thinking about his new job

award.meaning: a prize given for an achievement
award.example: she won an award for her film

awoke.meaning: past tense of awake: stopped sleeping
